benchmarks.definition: no position at any time; return 0, cost 0, drawdown 0
buy BTCUSDT at the first eligible decision time of the evaluation window at the entry ask, hold to the last eligible decision time, sell at the exit bid; fees 10 bps per side once
benchmarks.meaningful_when: window >= 1 full day; reported as market reference, not as a hurdle for short-horizon trials

benchmarks.definition: at each daily decision time: LONG BTCUSDT for 24h if the BTCUSDT row has mom.ret_1d_1 > 0 (previous UTC day closed up), else FLAT; time exit after 24h
at each daily decision time: equal-weight LONG every eligible universe symbol with mom.ret_1d_1 > 0, FLAT the rest; hold 24h (long/flat because spot cannot short)

parameters.weighting: equal weight among selected; cash if none

benchmarks.universe: universe-asof at the decision time, all tiers

benchmarks.definition: realized forward outcomes of the running PAPER-R1 strategy (ID PAPER-R1-20261004T152643Z) from E = 2026-10-04T15:26:43.497803Z onward, under PAPER-R1 governance, as forward evidence only (never a tuning set)
benchmarks.eligibility_condition: only after a separately authorized, predeclared PAPER-R1 linkage (exe.paper_outcome is null: paper_r1_linkage_not_authorized) and only for windows >= E; never W3

common.costs: same execution_model and cost cascade as the hypotheses (protocol)
common.decision_daily: the first decision time of each UTC day: 00:06:30Z (grid-15m-plus390s-v1)
common.ledger: each benchmark evaluation is registered as a ledger trial with hypothesis_id H-P2D-BENCH-v1 (counted separately; never selected)
common.periods: identical evaluation windows (folds) as the trials compared; never W3; never pre-E

never_named_B3: B3 is the production risk breaker; no benchmark is called B3
